source: Emperor Xiaowen was the eldest son of Emperor Gaozu. In the spring of the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, Chen Xi's army was defeated and Dai was pacified. Emperor Xiaowen was made King of Dai and his capital was Zhongdu. He is the son of Queen Mother Bo. In the seventeenth year of his reign as King of Dai, it was the eighth year of the reign of Emperor Gao. In July of this year, Queen Gao passed away. In September, Lu Chan and others from Empress Lu's family wanted to rebel and overthrow the Liu family's regime. The ministers annihilated the Lu family together and discussed summoning the king to come to the capital and establish him as emperor. This incident is recorded in "The Chronicles of Empress Dowager Lu". Prime Minister Chen Ping, Taiwei Zhou Bo and others sent people to greet the king. The king asked his ministers, Lang Zhongling, Zhang Wu and others for their opinions. Zhang Wu and others suggested: The ministers in the Han Dynasty were all generals from the time of Emperor Gao. They were familiar with military affairs and were scheming and deceitful. Their real intention was not just that, they were just afraid of the power of Emperor Gao and Empress Dowager Lu. Now that the Lu family has been annihilated and the capital has been bloodbathed, they are here to greet the king in name, but in fact they cannot be trusted. I hope that the king will pretend to be ill, not go to the capital, and sit back and watch the situation change. Lieutenant Song Chang said: The opinions of the ministers are all wrong. When the corruption of the Qin Dynasty collapsed, the princes and heroes rose up at the same time, thinking that they could conquer the world. There were tens of thousands of people. However, it was the Liu family who finally ascended to the position of emperor. Those who competed in the world cut off the hope of becoming emperor. This is the first point. Emperor Gao made his children kings, and the territories of the kingdoms were intertwined. This is what people call a clan that is as solid as a rock. Everyone in the world succumbed to the strength of the Liu family. This is the second point. The rise of the Han Dynasty abolished the harsh decrees of the Qin Dynasty, simplified the laws, and benefited the people. Everyone lived peacefully and unshakably. This is the third point. With the majesty of the Empress Dowager Lu, she established three of Lu's children as kings, who excelled in power and autocratic power. However, the Taiwei entered the Northern Army with integrity. When he called out, the soldiers all bared their left arms to support the Liu family and betrayed the Lu family. As a result, the Lu family was wiped out. This is a gift from God and cannot be achieved by human beings. Now even if the ministers want to rebel, the people are unwilling to be driven by them. Can their party members unite together wholeheartedly? Today, there are relatives like Zhu Xuhou and Dongmuhou in the capital, and outside the capital there are people who are afraid of the power of the King of Wu, the King of Chu, the King of Huainan, the King of Langxie, the King of Qi, and the King of Dai. At present, the only sons of Emperor Gao are the King of Huainan and the Great King. The Great King is older, famous for his virtuousness, saintliness, benevolence, and filial piety. Therefore, the ministers comply with the wishes of the people in the world and want to welcome the Great King as the emperor. The Great King has no doubts. The king reported to the queen mother and held consultations, but he hesitated and did not make up his mind. Use tortoise shells for divination, and the omens of the hexagrams will be great. The omen said: Daheng heralds a change. I will become the king of heaven and carry forward the cause of the late emperor like Xia Qi.
gold_target: Emperor Xiaowen, the eldest son of Emperor Gaozu, was made King of Dai after Chen Xi's defeat in the spring of Gaozu's eleventh year, with his capital at Zhongdu. The king consulted his ministers; Zhang Wu advised caution, suspecting the ministers' intentions, while Song Chang argued that the Liu family's rule was divinely ordained, the people were loyal, and the king, as the eldest surviving son of Emperor Gaozu, was the rightful choice. After divination showed a favorable omen, the king sent his uncle Bo Zhao to verify the ministers' sincerity. Confirmed, he traveled to Chang'an, where he was greeted by officials. source: The princes, kings, clans, brothers, and meritorious ministers are all wise and virtuous people. The officials all requested resolutely: In ancient times, the Yin and Zhou dynasties established the country and brought peace and order to the world for more than a thousand years. source: When Liu Xingju, the king of Jibei, heard that the emperor was going to Dai and preparing to attack the Xiongnu, he took the opportunity to rebel and dispatched troops to attack Xingyang. So the emperor issued an edict to the prime minister to stop attacking the Xiongnu, and sent Chen Wu, Marquis of Jipu, as a general to lead an army of 100,000 to attack the King of Jibei. Qihou Zanhe was made a general and stationed in Xingyang. On July 18, when the emperor returned to Chang'an from Taiyuan, he issued an edict to the officials: The King of Jibei violated morality and rebelled against the emperor, causing trouble for the officials and the people. It was a treasonous act. If the army has not arrived, and the officials and people of Jibei settle down first, as well as those who surrendered with the army and local cities, they will be pardoned and their original official positions and titles will be restored. Those who rebelled and returned with Liu Xingju, King of Jibei, were also pardoned. In August, the army of Jibei feudal state was defeated and the king of Jibei was captured. Pardon the officials and people of the feudal state of Jibei who followed the king of Jibei and rebelled. In the sixth year, officials reported that Huainan King Liu Chang had abandoned the decrees of the late emperor and did not obey the emperor's edicts. The palace he lived in was not in compliance with the law. The ministers discussed it and all said that Chang Liu should be executed on the street and his body exposed to the public. The emperor could not bear to deal with King Huainan according to the law, so he pardoned his sins and deposed him from the throne. The ministers requested that King Huainan be exiled to the Qiongdu area of ​​Yandao, Shu County, and the emperor agreed. Liu Chang died of illness on the road before he reached the place where he was exiled. The emperor took pity on him. Later, in the sixteenth year, he honored Liu Chang, King of Huainan, with the posthumous title of King Li, and named his three sons King of Huainan, King of Hengshan, and King of Lujiang. In the summer of the thirteenth year, the emperor said: I heard that disasters arise from resentment, and happiness arises from virtue. This is the law of God. I should be personally responsible for the mistakes of all officials. Now the officials praying secretly blame the ministers below, which makes my immorality even more obvious. I strongly disapprove of this approach. It should be abolished. In May, Taicang of Qi State ordered Chunyu Gong to commit a crime and should be punished. He was arrested and detained in Chang'an. The Duke of Taicang had no boys, but five daughters. When the Duke of Taicang was arrested and leaving, he scolded his daughter and said: "Whoever gives birth to a child but does not give birth to a boy has an urgent matter and it is of no use at all!" His youngest daughter Tiying cried sadly alone and followed her father to Chang'an. She wrote a letter saying: My father is an official, and people in Qi state praise him for being honest and fair. Now he should be punished for breaking the law. I am saddened that the dead cannot be resurrected, and those who are under punishment cannot join their limbs together again. Although I want to change my ways, there is no way out. I am willing to be taken into the government as a slave to atone for my father's punishment so that he can change his ways. Tiying's petition was sent to the emperor. The emperor felt pity for her and issued an edict: I heard that during the Yu family, criminals were painted on their clothes and hats to make them different from ordinary people, in order to humiliate the criminals and the people did not violate the law. What is the reason for this? It's because the politics are extremely clear. Now the law stipulates three types of corporal punishment, but evil and illegal things cannot be prohibited. Where is the fault? Isn't it because my virtue is poor and my education is not obvious?

source: The marriage has been decided and will start this year. In the winter of AD 6, 30,000 Xiongnu entered Shangjun, and 30,000 Xiongnu entered Yunzhong. The emperor favored the world, ordered the princes not to pay tribute to the court, abolished the ban on mountains, forests and lakes, reduced the emperor's clothing, utensils, and dogs and horses for play, reduced the number of ministers, opened granaries, provided relief to the poor, and the people could sell their titles to buy food. Emperor Xiaowen came to the capital from Daiguo and reigned for twenty-three years. Nothing was added to the palaces, gardens, dogs and horses, clothing, and utensils. If there were any inconveniences to the people, they were changed to benefit the people. I once planned to build a terrace and asked a craftsman to calculate the cost. One hundred pounds of gold was needed. The emperor said: One hundred kilograms of gold is equivalent to the property of ten families of ordinary people. I enjoy the palace of the late emperor, and I am often worried that I will humiliate the late emperor. Why build this terrace? The emperor often wore thick silk clothes, and his beloved Mrs. Shen was not allowed to drag her clothes to the ground, and her draperies were not allowed to have embroidery or brocade in order to show her honesty and simplicity, and to set an example for the world. All mausoleums are built with earthenware, and gold, silver, copper, and tin are not allowed to be used for decoration. No tall tombs are built, in order to save some money and not disturb the people. The king of Nanyue, Wei Tuo, proclaimed himself Emperor Wu, but the emperor called Wei Tuo's brother and gave high-ranking officials generous salaries in return. Wei Tuo canceled his imperial title and professed himself to the Han Dynasty. After making peace with the Xiongnu, the Xiongnu violated the treaty and invaded the border to plunder. However, the emperor only ordered the border fortresses to strengthen their defense and did not send troops deep into the hinterland of the Xiongnu for fear of disturbing the people. King Wu pretended to be ill and did not go to the capital to attend court. The emperor immediately rewarded him with a sitting table and a cane. Although ministers such as Yuan An and others discussed matters sharply and urgently, the emperor often adopted their suggestions with a tolerant attitude. Among the ministers, Zhang Wu and others accepted money bribes. When they found out, the emperor took out the money from his treasury and rewarded them, which made them feel ashamed and did not hand it over to the officials for punishment. The emperor devoted himself wholeheartedly to educating the people with morality. Therefore, there was prosperity and a culture of paying attention to etiquette and justice in the four seas. On June 1, the seventh year of AD, the emperor died in Weiyang Palace. His last edict before his death was: I heard that all things in the world grow and nothing survives death. source: When the generals went out to fight, they each appointed prefectures, pastors, and county guards. The prefectures and counties established were intertwined with each other, and the people did not know whose instructions to follow. In December, the red eyebrow army entered the pass westward. In the first month of the third year, Fang Wang, a native of Pingling, made his former son Liu Ying the emperor. At the beginning, Fang Wang saw the political chaos in Gengshi and speculated that he would be defeated, so he told Gong Lin and others from Anling: The former Ding'an Duke Liu Ying was a descendant of Emperor Ping. Although Wang Mang usurped the throne, Liu Ying was also the leader of the Han Dynasty. Now people are saying that the direct descendant of the Liu family should be appointed emperor. Let's come together to build a great cause with him. What do you think? Gong Lin and others agreed. So he found Liu Ying in Chang'an and took him to Linjing to formally establish him as emperor. Gathering thousands of party members, Fang Wang became Prime Minister and Gong Lin became Grand Sima. Gengshi sent Li Song and general Su Mao to defeat Fang Wang and others, killing several of them. He also ordered Su Mao to resist Chimei in Hongnong. Su Mao's army was defeated and more than a thousand people died. In March, Li Song was sent to join Zhu Tuna and Chimei to fight in Guixiang. Li Song and others were defeated, abandoned the army and fled, with more than 30,000 people killed. At this time, Wang Kuang and Zhang Xuan were stationed in Hedong. They were defeated by Deng Yu and rushed back to Chang'an. Zhang discussed with the generals and said: "Red Eyebrow is close to the underworld of Zheng and Hua, and will be here day and night." Now there is only Chang'an, which is about to be wiped out. It is better to command the army to plunder the property in the city to make a fortune, then attack the places along the way from here, return east to Nanyang, and collect the soldiers of King Wan and others. If things don't work out, just go into the lake and become a robber again. Shen Tujian, Liao Zhan and others all agreed, so they went together to persuade Gengshi. Gengshi was furious after hearing this and refused to agree. Zhang Xun and others did not dare to say anything more. When Chi Mei made Liu Penzi emperor, Gengshi sent Wang Kuang, Chen Mu, Cheng Yue and Zhao Meng to garrison Xinfeng and Li Song to garrison the city to resist them. Zhang Xian, Liao Zhan, Hu Yin, Shen Tujian and others conspired with the imperial censor Kui Xiao to use force to hijack Gengshi during the Liqiu Festival in order to complete the plan proposed above. Attendant Liu Nengqing learned of their plot and reported it to Gengshi. Gengshi pretended to be ill and did not leave the palace, so he summoned Zhang Xuan and others. Zhang Xuan and others came in, and Gengshi prepared to kill them all, but only Wei Xiao could not reach them. Gengshi was suspicious and ordered Zhang Xian and four others to wait in the house outside temporarily. Zhang Xun, Liao Zhan, and Hu Yin suspected that something had happened and rushed out. Only Shentu Jian was there, and Gengshi killed him. Zhang Xuan, Liao Zhan, and Hu Yin then led their troops to plunder the east and west cities. When it was dark, they broke into the palace and fought in the palace. Gengshi was defeated. Early the next morning, he led his wife and more than a hundred chariots and rode eastward to Zhao Meng's place in Xinfeng. Gengshi also suspected that Wang Kuang, Chen Mu, Cheng Dan and Zhang Xuan were conspiring, so he summoned them at the same time. Chen Mu and Cheng Dan arrived first and were beheaded immediately. Wang Kuang could not be frightened and led his army to Chang'an to meet Zhang and others. Li Song returned to Gengshi and joined forces with Zhao Meng to attack Wang Kuang and Zhang Xuan in the city. After fighting for more than a month, Wang Kuang and others were defeated and Gengshi moved to Changxin Palace. When Chimei arrived at Gaoling, Wang Kuang and others surrendered to Chimei, so he and Chimei marched together. Gengshi defended the city and sent Li Song to fight, but failed and more than two thousand people died. Chimei captured Li Song alive. At this time, Li Song's younger brother Li Fan was the captain of the city gate. Red Eyebrow sent an envoy to Li Fan and said: "Open the city gate and spare your brother's life." Li Fan opened the door. In September, Red Eyebrow entered the city. Gengshi fled alone and came out of the kitchen city gate. Many women shouted from behind: Your Majesty should dismount his horse and seize the city! Gengshi dismounted and thanked him, then mounted his horse and ran away. At first, the servant Liu Gong tied himself up and went to prison to plead guilty because he had made his younger brother Liu Penzi emperor with his red eyebrows. Hearing that Gengshi had failed, he was released from prison. Follow Gengshi on foot to Gaoling and stay at the post station. Yan Ben, the right auxiliary captain, was afraid that Chimei would not let Gengshi go if he let him go, so he led his troops to station outside, claiming to be stationing troops to protect Gengshi but actually imprisoning him. Chimei passed down a letter saying: If the Holy Duke is willing to surrender, he will be named King of Changsha. But after twenty days, I refused to accept it. Gengshi sent Liu Gong to ask for surrender from Chimei, who sent his general Xie Lu to accept the surrender. In October, Gengshi followed Xie Lu naked to Changle Palace and dedicated the emperor's seal and ribbon to Liu Penzi. Chimei's guilt was changed and he was placed in the court and prepared to be killed. Liu Gong and Xie Lu interceded for Gengshi, but Chimei didn't agree, so they took Gengshi away. Liu Gong chased after him and said: I am trying my best to protect the Holy Duke. Please let me die in front of the Holy Duke. He drew his sword and wanted to commit suicide. Fan Chong, the commander of the red eyebrows, and others quickly rescued him, so they pardoned Gengshi and made him a Marquis of Weiwei. Liu Gong once again interceded for Gengshi, and actually made Gengshi the King of Changsha. Gengshi often lived with Xie Lu, and Liu Gong also protected him. The three assistants suffered from the tyranny of Chimei and all sympathized with Gengshi, but Zhang Xun and others were deeply concerned and said to Xie Lu: Now the commanders of the battalions want to capture Shenggong. Once you lose Shenggong and everyone joins forces to attack you, you will be destroying yourself. So Xie Lu sent his soldiers to go to the countryside to herd horses with Gengshi, and secretly ordered his soldiers to strangle Gengshi. Liu Gong went to collect Gengxi's body at night. Guangwu was very sad when he heard the news, and ordered Deng Yu, the chief minister, to bury Gengshi in Ba Ling.

source: Among them, the highest-ranking ones are the three elders, followed by the engaged ones, and the third ones are the pawns. They are generally called "giants". Wang Mang sent Peng Liandan and Taishi Wang Kuang to attack. Fan Chong and others prepared to fight, but he was worried that his subordinates would be confused with Wang Mang's soldiers, so he ordered his subordinates to paint their eyebrows red to distinguish them, and they were known as red eyebrows from then on. Chimei defeated Lian Dan and Wang Kuang's army, killing more than ten thousand people, and chased them to Wuyan. Lian Dan died in the battle and Wang Kuang fled for his life. Fan Chong led more than 100,000 troops and returned to surround Ju County for several months. Someone said to Chong: Ju is the hometown of our parents, why should we attack it? Fan Chongnai came to the rescue and left. At this time, Lu's mother died of illness, and her subordinates joined the Red Eyebrow, Qingdu, and Bronze Horse tribes. The Red Eyebrow Army invaded Donghai County and fought against Wang Mang Dayin of Yiping County. They failed and thousands of people died. Then they left Donghai and plundered Chu, Pei, Runan, and Yingchuan. They returned to Chenliu, captured Lu City, and moved to Puyang. It happened that Gengshi decided to make his capital Luoyang and sent envoys to persuade Fan Chong to surrender. When Fan Chong and others heard that the Han Dynasty was revived, they left their troops behind and personally led more than 20 generals to accompany the envoys to Luoyang to surrender and reform. They were all granted the title of marquis. Fan Chong and others did not have their own fiefdom, and the tribesmen who stayed behind slowly began to rebel. Fan Chong left Luoyang and returned to his barracks. He led his army into Yingchuan County and divided his tribe into two divisions, one with Fan Chong and Pang An, and one with Xu Xuan, Xie Lu, and Yang Yin. Fan Chong and Pang An captured Changshe County, attacked Wancheng in the south, and beheaded the county magistrate; while Xu Xuan, Xie Lu, and others also captured Yangzhai County and led their troops to Liang County to kill the Henan prefect. Although the Red Eyebrow tribe had won many battles, they were exhausted and tired of fighting. They cried day and night and wanted to return eastward. Fan Chong and others discussed and considered that once they returned eastward, the tribe would inevitably disperse, so it was better to attack Chang'an westward. In the winter of the second year of Gengshi, Fan Chong and Pang An arrived at Wuguan, while Xu Xuan and others advanced from Luhun Pass in two directions. In the first month of the third year, they all arrived in Hongnong County and won consecutive battles with Gengshi generals, and the army developed greatly. So ten thousand people were divided into one battalion, and a total of thirty battalions were built. Each battalion had three elders and one person in charge; they entered Huayin. In the army, Qi witches often played drums and danced to worship King Cheng Yangjing for blessings and peace. The wizard was talking nonsense, and King Jing was furious and said: When you are the emperor, why should you be a thief? Those who laughed at the witches became ill, and the army was frightened. At this time, Fang Wang's younger brother Fang Yang resented Gengshi for killing his brother, so he wrote to Fan Chong and others, saying: Gengshi was in chaos and the government's orders were ineffective, which is why the general reached this point. Now the general has millions of people marching west to the imperial capital Chang'an, but he has no title and is called a group of thieves. This cannot last long. It is better to establish the Liu clan and carry out executions under the banner of justice. Who dares to disobey this order? Fan Chong and others thought this was good. Fan Chong advanced to Zheng County and discussed with the generals: Now that our army is approaching Chang'an, and ghosts and gods appear like this, we should ask the Liu clan to jointly establish him as emperor. In June, Liu Penzi was made emperor and named himself the first year of the founding of the world. At first, Chimei passed through Shixian County and captured Liu Penzi and his two brothers Liu Gong and Liu Mao, all of whom remained in the army. Liu Gong studied "Shang Shu" since he was a child and understood some of the great meanings in the book. Later, he surrendered to Gengshi with Fan Chong and others, and was named Shihou. Because he was proficient in Confucian classics, he wrote many times to discuss matters, and he was appointed as a servant. He stayed in Chang'an from Gengshi. Liu Penzi and Liu Mao stayed in the Red Eyebrow Army and belonged to Liu Xiaqing, a soldier in the right school. They were responsible for cutting grass and feeding cattle, and were known as "cow officials". Later, Fan Chong and others wanted to establish an emperor and searched for the descendants of King Chengyang Jing who were in the army. They found more than seventy people in total. Only Liu Penzi was the closest relative to Liu Mao and the former Marquis of Xi'an Liu Xiao. Fan Chong and others discussed it and said: I heard that in ancient times the emperor led troops and was called a general. So he used a piece of wood to write a sign of "General", and put two blank pieces of wood of the same size in the basket, so he set up an altar in Zhengbei to worship King Cheng Yangjing. The three elders and businessmen gathered under the steps. Liu Penzi, Liu Mao, and Liu Xiao stood in the middle, picking up wood chips in order of age. Liu Penzi was the youngest and the last one to touch it, and happened to touch the middle piece of wood. All the generals in the audience congratulated Liu Penzi on his submission. Liu Penzi was only fifteen years old at this time, with his hair disheveled, bare feet, and rags. He was blushing and sweating and was so frightened that he almost cried when he saw everyone kneeling down to him. Liu Mao said to him: Hide the wood pieces well. Liu Penzi immediately bit off the wood pieces and threw them away, then returned to Liu Xiaqing. I have been here for eight generations, and with my humble talents, I have been in power for ten years. Even though he knew that speaking out would lead to death, he risked his life to speak out his loyal words, but he couldn't bear to see the disaster coming and kept silent and tried to save his life. At this time, King Liu Kang of Jinan was very proud, so Dou Xian proposed to make He Chang the Taifu of Jinan. When He Chang arrived in Jinan, he assisted Liu Kang with moral principles and gave him advice and corrections several times. However, Liu Kang was very polite. More than a year later, He Chang was promoted to the prefect of Runan. He Chang hated the civil and secular officials who sought reputation for being harsh, so he used leniency and gentleness in his official duties. On the day of the beginning of spring, the governor was summoned back to the government, and Confucian officials were assigned to the county to commend those who were filial and righteous. Judgment of unjust cases shall be based on the righteousness and law of the Spring and Autumn Annals. Therefore, there was no voice of resentment in the county, and the people were influenced by the kindness. Those who lived outside the country went home to support their parents. Those whose parents died were dressed in mourning, and there were more than 200 people who gave away their wealth. Establish ritual officials but not civil servants. The old Yutongyang canal was also repaired, which the people relied on for irrigation, and the cultivated land increased by more than 30,000 hectares. Officials carved stones and erected monuments praising He Chang's merits. Later, the Dou family failed, and a minister reported that He Chang's son had a close friendship with Xia Yanghou, so he was relieved of his official position. In the twelfth year of Yongyuan, he was recruited again and moved to Wugan Zhonglang general for three times. He Chang often hated Cai Lun, the official servant of Zhongchang, and Lun deeply regretted it. In the first year of Yuanxing, He Chang was not fasting because of the seriousness of the temple. Later, Empress Deng went to the tomb of Taifu Yuzhong, and He Chang went to the meeting with hundreds of officials. Cai Lun then played He Chang for pretending to be ill, so as to atone for the crime. Died at home.

source: ◆The biography of Yang Zhen, named Boqi, was from Hongnong Huayin. Yang happy, the eighth generation ancestor, was granted the title of Marquis of Chiquan due to his merit during the reign of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty. His father, Yang Bao, studied Ouyang Shangshu. During the reigns of Emperor Ai and Emperor Ping, he did not care about worldly affairs and taught in seclusion. In the second year of residence, he was drafted together with Gong Sheng, Gong She and Jiang Xu. However, he refused and ran away without knowing where he was. Emperor Guangwu admired his integrity very much. During the Jianwu period, he was specially recruited on the bus, but he died at home because he was old and sick. Yang Zhen loved learning when he was young. He studied "Ouyang Shangshu" from Taichang Huanyu. He was proficient in classics, read a lot of books, and devoted himself to research. At that time, Confucian scholars said: Confucius Yang Boqi in Kansai. He lives in Hucheng and has not accepted invitations from prefectures and counties for decades. Many people said that he was old and should go out to become an official. Yang Zhen's determination not to be an official became even more determined. Later, a crested sparrow took three fishes and flew in front of the lecture hall. The lecturer held the fish and said: Snakes are the symbol of Doctor Qing's clothes. Three means three stations, and Mr. will be promoted from now on. He became a state and county official only when he was fifty years old. General Deng Zhi heard that Yang Zhen was a talented person and promoted him to Maocai. He was promoted four times to the governor of Jingzhou and the governor of Donglai. When he went to the county and passed through Changyi, Wang Mi, the most talented person in Jingzhou whom he had recommended in the past, was serving as the county magistrate of Changyi. He went to see Yang Zhen and gave him ten pounds of gold in the evening. Yang Zhen said: Old friends know you, why don’t you know old friends? Wang Mi said: No one knows at night. Yang Zhen said: God knows, God knows, I know, you know, how can you say no one knows. Wang Mi left in shame. Later he became the prefect of Zhuo County. Be fair and honest, and do not accept personal requests. His descendants lived a vegetarian diet and lived a simple life. Some of his old friends or elders wanted him to buy property for his descendants. He said: Wouldn't it be nice to let future generations call them the descendants of innocent officials? In the fourth year of the Yuan Dynasty, he was recruited as a servant and promoted to Taichang. Most of the previous doctorate elections were not worthy of their name. Yang Zhen recommended Chen Liu, Yang Lun and other famous scholars who were proficient in Confucian classics to teach their studies, which was praised by Confucian scholars. In the first year of Yongning, he replaced Liu Kai as Situ. The following year, Empress Dowager Deng passed away, and some of the concubines that Emperor An liked became arrogant. Emperor An's nanny, Wang Sheng, was responsible for raising Emperor An. She relied on the emperor's favor and was lawless. Wang Sheng's daughter Bo Rong went in and out of the palace, taking bribes and perverting the law. Yang Zhen went to Shu. Said: I heard that politics relies on talents, and those pests must be removed to govern the country. Therefore, in the era of Tang Yao and Yu Shun, when outstanding talents were in power, the four bad guys Hundun, Qiongqi, Tao, and Taotie were all exiled to remote places. Everyone was convinced and the country was at peace. Morals were depraved, and the court was filled with despicable and sycophantic people. Wang Sheng came from a humble background and met with a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to raise Sheng Gong. Although she had some merit, the reward she received far exceeded her hard work. And she was greedy to no end. Asking for help outside, disturbing the world, harming the court, and bringing discredit on the emperor's face.

His father Yang Bao studied Ouyang Shangshu, lived in seclusion during the reigns of Emperors Ai and Ping, and refused official appointments, disappearing. Emperor Guangwu admired his integrity but he died at home due to old age and illness.

The emperor's uncle Dahong Geng Bao recommended the elder brother of Li Gui, who often served as a servant, to Yang Zhen, but Yang Zhen refused. Geng Bao went to ask Yang Zhen and said: "Li Changshi is the most important person in the country. The emperor wants you to recommend his brother. I, Geng Bao, am just conveying the emperor's opinion." Yang Zhen said: If the imperial court wants to have the three prefectures recommend candidates, there should be an order from the minister. Rejecting him, Geng Bao left in anger. The queen's brother Zhi Jinwu Yan Xian also recommended to Yang Zhen that he befriend his relatives, but Yang Zhen refused. Sikong Liu heard the news and immediately recommended these two people, and both were promoted within ten days. Therefore, Yang Zhen suffered even more resentment. At that time, an edict was sent to build a house for Queen Mother. Fan Feng, the chief minister, and Zhou Guang, Xie Yun, etc., encouraged them to disturb the court. Yang Zhen went to Shu again. Said: I heard that in ancient times, after nine years of farming, there must be three years of savings. Therefore, floods caused disasters in Yao's time, and the people did not suffer from hunger. Now the disaster is serious and the people are empty and unable to provide for themselves. In addition, the locusts are causing damage, the Qiang bandits are looting, and the border areas are uneasy. The fighting has not continued until now, and the soldiers have no food and grass. The treasury of Da Sinong is empty, which is not a time for national peace. The edict was written to build a house inside Jincheng Gate for my mother, which was combined into one, connected to the street, and decorated with carvings, which was extremely gorgeous. It is now summer, when the soil is prosperous, and they go up to the mountains to quarry stone. The master craftsmen from Zuo School and other departments are working on dozens of places, urging each other, and spending more than hundreds of millions! Brothers Zhou Guang and Xie Yun, who had no flesh-and-blood ties to the country, relied on a group of treacherous men to share authority and power with Fan Feng, Wang Yong and others, liaise with the prefectures and counties, and evade the ministers. The recruitment of the prime minister was carried out in accordance with the orders from above. Corrupt people from all over the country were recruited and bribes were accepted from them. Even those who had not used the bribes were reused. Confusing black and white, not distinguishing between pure and dirty, the whole world was in an uproar, and they all said: The wealth is in the upper reaches, which is a source of ridicule for the court. I heard the teacher say: When the money is used up, there will be resentment; when the labor is used up, there will be rebellion. Resentful people should not be used again. So it is said: If the people are not enough, who will be enough for you? I hope the emperor will consider it. Fan Feng, Xie Yun and others saw that Yang Zhen's many suggestions were not adopted, so they had no scruples. This is to open up channels of speech, brainstorm ideas, and make people feel better. Now that Zhao Teng has been convicted of attacking and slandering, which is different from the crime of murder, I ask the emperor to reduce the crime, save Teng's life, and inspire the people to dare to speak. The emperor ignored him and Zhao Teng was killed. In the spring of the third year, the emperor ascended Mount Tai, and Fan Feng and others took the opportunity to compete for house repairs. Yang Zhen sent Gao Shu to summon the master craftsman Shi Shi to investigate the matter. After obtaining the false edict from Zhao Feng and others, he wrote a memorial and wanted to wait for the emperor to return before delivering it. When Fan Feng and others heard about it, they were terrified. It happened that Taishi said that Xingbian was rebellious, so he framed Yang Zhen together and said: Since Zhao Teng's death, Yang Zhen has been deeply resentful. And he held a grudge against Deng Zhi's old subordinates. When the emperor returned, he waited in Taixue for an auspicious day to enter the palace. In the evening, he sent an envoy with an order to collect Taiwei Yang Zhen's seal and ribbon. Yang Zhen then closed the door to exclude guests. Fan Feng and others still hated him, so they asked General Geng Bao to report that Minister Yang Zhen refused to plead guilty and was resentful, and ordered him to be sent back to his hometown. Yang Zhen walked to Jiyang Pavilion in the west of the city and said generously to his son and student: Death is inevitable for a person. I am favored and occupy the position, but I hate the traitorous ministers who are cunning but cannot be punished, and the evil mistresses who are causing chaos but cannot be restrained. How can I show my face to the world? On the day of death, a coffin of mixed wood is used, and the body is only covered with a sheet. There is no burial place or a shrine. So he took poison and died at the age of seventy. In response to the orders of Fan Feng and others, the prefect of Hongnong moved to Liang and sent officials to stay at Yang Zhen's funeral in Shaanxi County. They exposed the coffin beside the road and ordered Yang Zhen's disciples to post and write letters on their behalf. Everyone on the road shed tears for it. When Emperor Shun was over, Fan Feng, Zhou Guang and others were put to death. Yang Zhen was a student of Yu Fang, and Chen Yi went to the court to complain about Yang Zhen. The imperial court called him Yang Zhenzhong. He issued an edict to confer the title of Lang to his two sons, gave him a million yuan in money, and buried Yang Zhen in Tongting, Huayin with proper ceremony. Ten days before the burial, a large bird with a height of more than ten feet flew to Yang Zhen's funeral. It leaned down and screamed in mourning, weeping on the wet ground. After the burial, it flew away. The county reported the situation. At that time, disasters occurred one after another. The emperor felt that Yang Zhen was an unjust case, and issued an edict saying: The late Taiwei Yang Zhen was an upright person, so he assisted in current affairs. My stupidity aggravated this sin. The mountains collapsed and the pillars were broken. How dangerous I was! Now let the prefect and prime minister use the palace to have a shrine with soul and spirit, or come and enjoy these sacrifices of mine. So people erected a stone bird statue in front of Yang Zhen's tomb to commemorate him. Yang Zhen was framed, Gao Shu was also convicted, and he was accused of reducing his death. When Yang Zhen was vindicated, Gao Shu paid homage to the censor and went to Jingzhou to judge the history. Yang Zhen has five sons. The eldest son Yang Mu was appointed Prime Minister of Fubo.

source: Dong Zhuo, courtesy name Zhongying, was from Lintao, Longxi. He has a rough and scheming temperament. When he was young, he traveled among the Qiang and tried his best to make friends with the leaders. Later, when he returned home to farm, some of the leaders came to join him. Dong Zhuo slaughtered cattle for them and had banquets with them. The leaders thanked him for his kindness and collected the remaining heads of various livestock as gifts to him after returning. From then on, he became famous for his bravery and chivalry. The soldiers and horses who were appointed as state guards once patrolled and guarded under the fortress. Dong Zhuo has extraordinary physical strength. He wears two bow boxes and shoots them left and right. The Qiang and Hu people are afraid of him. In the last years of Emperor Huan's reign, as a son of a good family in six counties, he was appointed Yulin Lang, and followed Zhang Huan, the general of Zhonglang, as a military commander. Together they went to attack the rebellious Qiang people in Hanyang. After defeating them, he was named Langzhong and was rewarded with nine thousand bundles of silk. Dong Zhuo said: I am the one who records the merits, and the soldiers are the ones who make the merits. So they were all distributed to the soldiers, leaving nothing behind. He was gradually promoted to the rank of captain of Wuji School in the Western Regions, but was dismissed for some reasons. Later he became the governor of Bingzhou and the governor of Hedong. In the first year of Zhongping, he was appointed as Shu Zhonglang General. With integrity, he went to Xiaquyang to attack Zhangjiao on behalf of Lu Zhi. He was defeated and punished. That winter, the Ling Qiang and Paohan Heguan bandits in the north rebelled, so they jointly supported Beigong Boyu and Li Wenhou, the Hu people who had surrendered to Huangzhong, as generals, and killed the Qiang captain Ling Zheng. Boyu and others kidnapped Bian Zhang and Han Sui, who came to Jincheng, and made them specialize in military administration. Together they killed Jincheng prefect Chen Yi, attacked and burned the prefectures and counties. In the spring of the next year, he led tens of thousands of cavalry to invade the Third Auxiliary and approached the royal cemetery, under the pretext of killing the eunuchs. He was initially elected as Xiaolian and appointed as the chief historian of Hanyang. At this time, the prefect of Wuwei relied on powerful officials, was corrupt, violent, and had no scruples, and was engaged in Wudu Su Zhenghe's investigation of his crimes. Liangzhou Governor Liang Hu was afraid of his noble relatives and wanted to kill Su Zhenghe to avoid the guilt of Wuwei Prefect, so he asked Gai Xun for advice. Gai Xun usually had a grudge against Su Zhenghe, and some people advised Gai Xun to take revenge on him. Gai Xun said: No. It is unfaithful to kill a good person because of something; it is unkind to take advantage of others when they are in danger to attack them. So he admonished Liang Hu and said: "I originally wanted to eat the eagle and the kite because I wanted to get the bird of prey. Now that I have the bird of prey and I cook and kill it, what's the use?" Liang Hu accepted his words. Su Zhenghe was happy that he was saved from being killed and ran to Gai Xun to thank him. Gai Xun refused to receive him and said, "I am offering advice for Liang Shijun, not for Su Zhenghe." He still hates Su Zhenghe as before. In the first year of Zhongping, the Qiang Hu and Bian Zhang from the north invaded Longyou, and the governor Zuo Chang cut off tens of millions due to the opportunity of the war. Gai Xun strongly remonstrated, but Zuo Chang became angry, so he ordered Gai Xun to station in Ayang to resist the bandit's elite troops, hoping to use military force to incriminate him. Gai Xun had many military exploits. Bian Zhang and others attacked Jincheng and killed the governor Chen Yi. Gai Xun persuaded Zuo Chang to rescue him. Zuo Chang didn't listen. Bian Zhang and others then surrounded Zuo Chang in Ji. Zuo Chang was afraid and asked Gai Xun to go. Gai Xun first stationed himself in Ayang with Xin Zeng and Kong Chang. When Zuo Chang's urgent military message arrived, Xin Zeng and Kong Chang hesitated and refused to go. Gai Xun said angrily: "In the past, Zhuang Jia supervised Sima Rangju's army. Because he did not arrive on time, Rangzhi acted according to military law and killed him. Is what we are doing now more valuable than overseeing the army in ancient times? Xin Zeng and others were afraid and had no choice but to listen to Gai Xun. Gai Xun immediately mobilized his troops to rescue Zuo Chang. When he arrived in Ji, he accused Bian Zhang and others of treason. They all said: If Ambassador Zuo had listened to you and led troops to attack me, I would have been able to correct my evil ways. Now my sin is too serious and I cannot surrender! So he withdrew the siege and left. Zuo Chang was summoned for the crime of cutting and intercepting, and he was replaced by Fufeng Song Xiao. Song Xiao suffered from the invasion and rebellion of foreign tribes in the border areas, and told Gai Xun: Liangzhou has repeatedly resisted riots because of its backward culture and lack of scholars. Now I want to write more "The Classic of Filial Piety" so that every household can learn it. This may help people know etiquette and justice. Gai Xun remonstrated: In the past, when the Grand Duke was granted the title of Qi, Cui Zhu killed Duke Zhuang of Qi, Bo Qin was granted the title of Lu, and Qing's father attacked and killed Duke Min of Lu. Are there still a shortage of scholars in these two countries? Don't rush to find a solution to the problem now. Doing such unrealistic things can not only make a state angry, but also make the court laugh. I don't know this is a good idea. Song Xiao refused to listen to him and went to the court to implement it. As expected, Gai Xun's words were not followed, so he was criticized by the imperial edict and summoned for being guilty of being conceited. At this time, the rebel Qiang surrounded Xia Yu, the Qiang guard captain. Gai Xun and the prefectures and counties jointly sent troops to rescue Xia Yu, but were defeated by the Qiang soldiers when they arrived in Hu. Gai Xun gathered more than a hundred defeated soldiers to form Yuli's formation. The elite Qiang cavalry attacked from both sides, and many soldiers died. Gai Xun was injured in three places, but he stood firm, pointed at the wooden sign and said: "Kill me here." In the sentence, I planted Qiang Dianwu. I had received Gai Xun's kindness on weekdays, so I stopped everyone with weapons and said: Gai Changshi is a wise man. Killing him is called deceiving the sky. Gai Xun raised his head and cursed: "You are a rebel, what do you know?" Come and kill me! The soldiers looked at me and I looked at you, shocked. Dian Wu jumped off his horse and asked Gai Xun to mount his horse. Gai Xun refused and was captured by the bandit soldiers. Qiang Rong admired Gai Xun's righteousness. He was brave enough to conquer the three armies and did not dare to harm him, so he was sent back to Hanyang. Later, the governor Yang Yong recommended Gai Xun to concurrently serve as the prefect of Hanyang. At that time, there was a famine and people were cannibalizing. Gai Xun allocated food to relieve the famine. He first took out his own food to set an example and saved more than a thousand hungry people. Later, he resigned from the official position and was conscripted as the captain of the school to fight against the captives. Emperor Ling summoned him and asked: Why is the world so rebellious? Gai Xun said: It was caused by the eunuch's children. At this time, Jian Shuo, the eunuch and commander of the military academy, was standing by. Emperor Ling turned back to Jian Shuo. Jian Shuo was afraid and didn't know how to persuade Gai Xun, so he hated Gai Xun. Emperor Ling said to Gai Xun again: "I have concentrated the troops in Pingtang. How about taking out more of the hidden treasures and giving them to the soldiers?" Gai Xun said: I heard that the late king Mingde did not show troops. Now the enemy is far away and arrayed nearby. This is not enough to show the country's courage and determination. It is just a waste of force. Emperor Ling said: Very good. It's a pity that it's too late to see you. My ministers have never said such things! At that time, Gai Xun, Zong Zheng, Liu Yu, and Assistant Military Colonel Yuan Shao were in charge of the emperor's security forces. Gai Xun said to Liu Yu and Yuan Shao: I have seen the emperor many times. The emperor is very smart, but he is just deceived by the left and right. If everyone worked together to kill the eunuchs, recruit and select handsome talents, revive the Han Dynasty, and retire with great success, wouldn't it be a great thing? Liu Yu and Yuan Shao had also discussed this matter on weekdays, so they contacted each other. Before they could take action, Sili Colonel Zhang Wen recommended Gai Xun to serve as Jing Zhaoyin.
gold_target: Gai Xun, from Dunhuang, was a Xiaolian and Hanyang's chief historian. He refused to take revenge on an enemy, Su Zhenghe, when the governor wanted to kill him to cover for a corrupt prefect, arguing it was wrong to kill a good man. He later remonstrated with Governor Zuo Chang for embezzling funds, but Zuo Chang sent him to a dangerous post. Gai Xun survived and later rescued Zuo Chang from a siege by Bian Zhang. He criticized Governor Song Xiao's plan to teach the *Classic of Filial Piety* to pacify the border, calling it impractical. During a battle against Qiang rebels, he was wounded but refused to flee, cursing his captors. The Qiang, respecting his courage, released him. As a famine relief official, he used his own grain to save over a thousand people. Summoned by Emperor Ling, he blamed eunuchs for the world's chaos. He planned with Liu Yu and Yuan Shao to kill the eunuchs, but was made Jing Zhaoyin instead. There, he prosecuted a corrupt official despite pleas from nobles. After Emperor Ling's death, he wrote to Dong Zhuo, criticizing his deposition of the young emperor. He openly defied Dong Zhuo in court, refusing to bow. He died of illness at 51, refusing Dong Zhuo's funeral gifts.

source: Zang Min led Chen Wei, the governor of Danyang, to defeat Xu Zhao. Xu Zhao still gathered his troops to harm the people. Zang Min and others sent troops to conquer and fought for three years before finally pacifying Xu Zhao, capturing Xu Zhao and his son, and killing thousands of people. Zang Min was promoted to be the envoy to the Xiongnu Zhonglang General. In the fifteenth year of Zang Hong's year, because of his father's contribution to the country, he was appointed Dong Zilang, who was famous in the Imperial Academy. His physical appearance is different from ordinary people. He was promoted to be filial and honest, and he was appointed as a complement to Lang Qiuchang. At the end of Zhongping Dynasty, he resigned and returned home. The prefect Zhang Chao asked him to be a meritorious official. At this time, Dong Zhuo killed the emperor and wanted to seize the Han Dynasty. Zang Hong said that Zhang Chao said: The prefect has been favored by the imperial court for generations, and his brothers have all served as high counties. Now the royal family is in danger, and thieves and ministers are watching. This is really the time for those who are loyal to the country to serve. Now that the county is still intact and the people are prosperous, if the war drums sound, we can gather 20,000 people and lead them to kill the national traitors and hold high the flag of righteousness for the world. Wouldn't it be great? Zhang Chao agreed with his opinion and went to Chenliu with Zang Hongxi to discuss with his brother Zhang Miao. Zhang Miao first said to Zhang Chao: I heard that you are a prefect and leave government affairs to Zang Hong. What kind of person is Zang Hong? Zhang Chao said: Zang Hong is a strange man in the country. He is more talented and resourceful than me. Zhang Miao immediately talked to Zang Hong and greatly appreciated him. He sent Zang Hong to see Liu Dai, the governor of Yanzhou, and Kong Danyou, the governor of Yuzhou, and they both became close friends with each other. Zhang Miao originally had an agreement. When Zhang Chao arrived, he made the decision, so he held a meeting with the herdsmen in Suanzao. They set up a altar and prepared to make an alliance, but they gave in to each other. No one dared to go first, and everyone recommended Zang Hong. Zang Hong then raised his clothes to the altar, expressed his blood and made an alliance, saying: The Han Dynasty was unlucky, and the rules and regulations of the court were in chaos. The traitor Dong Zhuo took the opportunity to cause harm, and the disaster fell on the emperor and poisoned the people. The most terrifying thing is that the Han Dynasty fell and the country was ruined. Liu Dai, the governor of Yanzhou, Kong Qianyou, the governor of Yuzhou, Zhang Miao, the governor of Chenliu, Qiao Mao, the governor of Dongjun, Zhang Chao, the governor of Guangling, etc., gathered volunteers to fight against the national calamity. All those who are in our alliance will work together to fulfill the loyalty of our ministers and kill their heads as they please without any second thought. If he violates the oath, he will die and die without any descendants. The emperor, the queen, the earth, the ancestors and the gods all learn from each other. Zang Hong's poems were so passionate that everyone who listened to them got excited. From then on, each army hesitated, and no one dared to go first, resulting in insufficient military supplies and the disintegration of the soldiers. At this time, Gongsun Zan, the commander-in-chief of the imperial army, had a disagreement with Liu Yu, the commander-in-chief. Zhang Chao sent Zang Hong to find Liu Yu to discuss the plan to defeat the bandits. When they walked to the river, they encountered a war between You and Ji, and the road was blocked, so they went to Yuan Shao's place. Yuan Shao met Zang Hong and admired his talent. He became friends with Zang Hong and asked Zang Hong to act as the governor of Qingzhou. The former governor, Jiao He, had a false reputation and was a master of empty words. At this time, yellow scarf thieves were scurrying everywhere, and the people in Qingzhou were rich and had many troops and equipment. Jiao He wanted to go to the capital with various allies, but before he left, the Yellow Turban thieves had already arrived, conquered the city and massacred the people. Jiao He didn't know anything about military affairs, so he just invited the witch Zhu Shi to his house to pray for God's blessing. He was also afraid that yellow turban thieves would cross the river during the freezing period, so he ordered many ice-trap pills to be made and placed in the river. His tribe was disbanded and Jiao He also died of illness. Zang Hong gathered together to comfort the scattered tribes, and the people were at peace. In the second year of his reign, Yuan Shao was afraid of his incompetence and appointed him as the prefect of Dongjun, with his capital in Dongwuyang. At this time, Cao Cao surrounded Zhang Chao in Yongqiu, and the situation was very dangerous. Zhang Chao said to the soldiers: Zang Hong is the only one who will come to save me today. Some people say: Yuan Shao and Cao Cao are getting along well, and Zang Hong is Yuan Shao's man. I'm afraid Zang Hong will not come far away, and he will bring disaster instead of good fortune. Zhang Chao said: Ziyuan is a righteous man in the world and will never deviate from his original aspirations. He may be held hostage by force, but there is nothing we can do! Zang Hong began to hear that Zhang Chao was surrounded, cried barefoot, and prepared his troops to rescue Zhang Chao. Thinking that his troops were too weak, he asked Yuan Shao for troops, but Yuan Shao refused. Zhang Chao's defense was breached and Zhang Chao's entire clan was killed. Zang Hong resented Yuan Shao and severed ties with him. Yuan Shao sent troops to surround Zang Hong, but could not capture it after many years. Yuan Shao sent Zang Hong to write a letter to Zang Hong from Chen Lin, a county resident, explaining the blessings and misfortunes to Zang Hong, and blaming each other with personal kindness and national justice.
gold_target: Zang Hong, from Guangling, was made a Dong Zilang due to his father's military merits. After Dong Zhuo killed the emperor, Zang Hong urged Prefect Zhang Chao to raise an army. He helped organize an alliance at Suanzao, where he gave a passionate oath, calling for the destruction of Dong Zhuo. The alliance, however, failed to act decisively. Later, Zang Hong served Yuan Shao as Qingzhou's governor, pacifying the region. When Cao Cao besieged Zhang Chao, Zang Hong begged Yuan Shao for troops to rescue him, but Yuan Shao refused. Zhang Chao was killed. Enraged, Zang Hong broke with Yuan Shao, who then besieged him. Despite a letter from Chen Lin urging surrender, Zang Hong refused, accusing Yuan Shao of betraying allies and killing loyal men. He stated he would rather die for righteousness. During the siege, he shared his last food with his soldiers and even killed his concubine to feed them. The city fell, and Zang Hong was captured. He defiantly cursed Yuan Shao for his treachery and was executed. His subordinate Chen Rong also chose to die with him.

source: ◆Yuan Shao Zhuan, Yuan Shao, courtesy name Benchu, was born in Ruyang, Runan, and was the grandson of Situ Yuan Tang. Yuan Shao's father, Yuan Cheng, had served as a lieutenant general with five senses. He was physically strong and liked to make friends. From the time of the great general Liang Ji, he was always friends with him. Yuan Shao served as a Langguan when he was young, and was later appointed as the Chief of Puyang. When his mother died, he resigned from the official position. After serving three years of funeral service, Yuan Shao recalled and lamented that he had lost his father since childhood and had to attend the funeral service for his father. After the mourning period expired, he moved to Luoyang. Yuan Shao was elegant, beautiful, kind to others, and focused on reputation. Yuan Shao's ancestors had served as three ministers for generations, and the guests came to join him. In addition, Yuan Shao lowered his status to befriend him, so all the scholars rushed to join him. Regardless of whether the scholars who came were high or low, Yuan Shaoyu and others were equal in etiquette. Various vehicles of visiting guests crowded the streets and alleys. The courtiers around the emperor were disgusted with him. Zhongchang Shi Zaozhong said in the ban: Yuan Benchu ​​does things to enhance his reputation and value, and likes to raise people who are not afraid of death. I don't know what this kid wants to do! After hearing this, Yuan Shao's uncle Taifu Yuan Wei called Yuan Shao and reprimanded him with the words of Zhong Zhong, but Yuan Shao never changed. Later, Yuan Shao was summoned by General He Jin as a subordinate officer and served as Shi Yushi and Huben Zhonglang General. In the fifth year of Zhongping, the imperial court began to set up eight Xiyuan captains and appointed Yuan Shao as the assistant military captain. When Emperor Ling died, Yuan Shao persuaded He Jin to recruit Dong Zhuo and other troops and coerced the Queen Mother to kill all the eunuchs. He Jin transferred Yuan Shao to serve as the captain of the Sili school. The incident has been recorded in "The Biography of He Jin". When Dong Zhuo led his army to the capital, Bao Xin, the cavalry captain from Taishan, persuaded Yuan Shao: If Dong Zhuo controls a powerful army, he will have the intention of rebelling. If we don't deal with it early, we will definitely be controlled by Dong Zhuo. When Dong Zhuo had just arrived and the soldiers were tired, they attacked Dong Zhuo and captured him. Yuan Shao was afraid of Dong Zhuo and did not dare to send troops. Soon, Dong Zhuo discussed deposing the emperor and establishing a new emperor. He said to Yuan Shao: The monarch who rules the world should find a wise person. Every time I think of Emperor Ling, it makes me angry. Marquis Dong seems to be okay, and he should be made emperor now. Yuan Shao said: "The emperor is young now and has done nothing wrong to spread the news to the world. If you ignore etiquette and follow your own desires, abolish your legitimate heir and establish your concubine as emperor, I am afraid that everyone will not think it is appropriate." Dong Zhuo put his sword in his hand and scolded Yuan Shao angrily, saying: How dare you talk like this! Don’t I have the final say in everything in the world? I want to do this, who dares to disobey! Yuan Shao replied wittily: This is a national matter. Please go outside to discuss it with the Taifu. Dong Zhuo also said: There are not enough descendants of the Liu family to keep. Yuan Shao was furious and said: "You are the only one who is tyrannical in the world, Dong Gong!" He laid out his sword, bowed to the end, and walked out. He hung the talisman on the upper door and fled to Jizhou.

source: Qu Yi pursued Gongsun Zan to the boundary bridge, and Gongsun Zan gathered his troops and turned back to fight again. Yuan Shao was more than ten miles behind. When he heard that Gongsun Zan had been defeated, he took off his saddle and let the horse rest. Yuan Shao connected the camps and gradually advanced, slowly approaching Guandu. The two sides fought. As a result, Cao's army was defeated and retreated to the camp to hold on. Yuan Shao built a tall watchtower and piled it into a mountain of earth, and fired arrows at Cao Cao's camp. The soldiers in the camp walked with shields on their heads. So Cao Cao used a stone chariot to fire stones and destroyed all Yuan Shao's watchtowers. The soldiers in the army called them "Thunderbolt Chariots". Yuan Shao dug tunnels to attack Cao Cao. Cao Cao immediately dug a long trench in the camp to stop Yuan Shao, and sent a surprise attack on Yuan's army's grain truck, burning all the grain. The two sides fought for more than a hundred days, and the people south of the Yellow River were exhausted. Many people betrayed Cao Cao and joined Yuan Shao. Yuan Shao sent Chunyu Qiong and others to lead more than 10,000 soldiers north to meet the troops transporting grain. Jushu persuaded Yuan Shao to send Jiang Qi to lead another army as foreign aid to cut off Cao Cao's looting. Yuan Shao disagreed. Xu You offered advice and said: Cao Cao has few soldiers and all his troops are used to resist our army. The remaining defense force in Xu County must be empty and weak. If another lightly-armed force is sent to attack day and night and capture Xu County, Cao Cao will naturally be captured. Even if Cao Cao's army is not defeated, they can be forced to run from both ends and they will definitely defeat Cao Cao. Yuan Shao couldn't accept it. It happened that someone in Xu You's family broke the law and was imprisoned. Xu You felt frustrated, so he defected to Cao Cao and suggested that Cao Cao sneak attack Chunyu Qiong and others. Chunyu Qiong and others were staying overnight at the Bird's Nest, which was forty miles away from Yuan Shao's troops. Cao Cao personally led five thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Chunyu Qiong and others overnight and wiped them out. Yuan Shao first learned that Cao Cao was attacking Chunyu Qiong, and said to his eldest son Yuan Tan: Even if Cao Cao defeats Chun Yuqiong and I capture Cao Cao's military camp, he will definitely have nowhere to return. gold_target: **Zheng Taichuan (Zheng Gongye)** was born in Kaifeng, Henan, as the great-grandson of Sinong Zheng Zhong. Talented from youth, his mother foresaw chaos in the final years of Emperor Ling's reign and secretly befriended heroes. Despite owning 400 hectares of land, he often lacked food. He was renowned throughout Shandong. Initially recommended for office, he declined multiple appointments. When General He Jin recruited him as Minister of the Secretariat and Censor, Zheng warned against recruiting Dong Zhuo, predicting his violent ambition would endanger the court. He Jin ignored this advice, so Zheng resigned. After He Jin was killed and Dong Zhuo rebelled, Zheng conspired with others to oppose Dong Zhuo. When Dong Zhuo wanted to attack the rebels, Zheng argued that governing depends on virtue, not military might. Fearing Dong Zhuo's anger, he fabricated a flattering analysis listing ten reasons why Dong Zhuo would defeat the rebels. source: The founder of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Emperor Guangwu Liu Xiu, whose courtesy name was Uncle Wen, was born in Caiyang, Nanyang. He was the ninth-generation grandson of Liu Bang, the great ancestor of the Han Dynasty. It comes from Liu Fa, the king of Shading who was born under Emperor Jing. Liu gave birth to Liu Mai, the Marquis of Chung Ling Festival, Liu Mai gave birth to Liu Wai, the governor of Yulin, Liu Hui, the captain of Julu, was born to Liu Wai, Liu Qin was born to Liu Qin, the Nandun order, and Liu Qin was born to Guangwu. Guangwu lost his father at the age of nine and was raised by his uncle Liu Liang. He is seven feet three inches tall, has thick eyebrows, a wide mouth, a protruding nose, and a full forehead. He is industrious by nature and enjoys farming. His elder brother Bo Sheng was fond of chivalry and raising people. He often ridiculed Guang Wu for only working in the fields and compared him with Liu Bang's second brother Liu Zhong. It was not until the reign of Wang Mang and Tianfeng that Guangwu came to Chang'an to study "Shang Shu" as a disciple and roughly understand the gist of the book. In Wang Mang's last years, there were successive locust plagues in the country, and bandits and bandits were raging. In the third year of Emperor Di Huang's reign, there was a serious famine in Nanyang, and most of the family's guests went out to rob and steal. In order to avoid the government, Guangwu fled to Xinye County and transported the harvested grain to Wancheng to sell. Li Tong and others from Wan used prophecies and talismans to tell Guangwu: The Liu family has risen again, and the Li family will be the assistant. Guangwu didn't dare to act rashly at first, but then he thought that his brother Bo Sheng would do great things by making friends with diners. Moreover, Wang Mang's regime showed signs of decline and destruction, and the world was in turmoil, so he planned with the Li family and decided to raise an army, so he began to purchase various weapons. In October, he and Li Tong's cousin Li Yi and others raised troops in Wancheng. He was 28 years old at the time. In November, the comet appeared in Zhangsu in the south. Guangwu then led his retainers back to Chongling. At this time, Bo Sheng had gathered the people to raise troops. At first, the children of each family were very frightened. They ran and hid, saying: "Bosheng wants to kill us!" When they saw Guangwu in crimson robes and crowns, they were all surprised and said: "Uncle Wen, who is cautious and kind, has also raised an army!" Only then did everyone settle down. Bo Sheng then recruited troops from Xinshi and Pinglin, and together with his leaders Wang Feng and Chen Mu, went west to attack Changju. Guangwu first rode the bull, and then he was able to ride the horse after killing Xin Yewei. He entered Tu Tangzi Township and killed the Huyang county captain. The wealth obtained by the army was unevenly distributed, and everyone was angry. The soldiers wanted to counterattack the Liu family. Guangwu then collected all the property from his clan and gave it all to the soldiers. Only then did everyone feel satisfied. He then attacked and captured Jiyang, and fought with Wang Mang's former commander Zhen Fu and Zhengliangqiu in Xiaochang'an. As a result, the Han army was defeated and had to retreat to Jiyang. On the first day of the first lunar month of the first year of Gengshi, the Han army fought against Zhenfu and Liangqiuci in the west of Xianshui River. They defeated the enemy and killed Zhenfu and Liangqiuci. Bo Sheng defeated Wang Mang's general Yan You and Zhizong's general Chen Mao in Huoyang, and then besieged Wancheng.

source: After repeated victories, the team moved forward. Guangwu led another 3,000 death squads and charged at the enemy's backbone from the water west of the city. Wang Xun and Wang Yi's military formations were in chaos. Guangwu used his vigor to destroy the enemy formation and killed Wang Xun. Kunyang City also beat drums and shouted and rushed out. The internal and external attacks were combined, the sound shook the heaven and the earth. The reckless army was defeated. The fleeing soldiers trampled each other, and the casualties were scattered for more than a hundred miles. There happened to be a strong thunder and strong wind in the sky, and the roof tiles were blown away. Heavy rain poured down and the water in the Sichuan River surged. Tigers and leopards trembled with fear. Soldiers rushed to cross the water to escape. Tens of thousands drowned and the river stopped flowing. Wang Yi, Yan You, and Chen Mao rode lightly on horseback and escaped across the river on the dead men. They were so powerful that the Mang army's food, grass, equipment, tanks, armor, and treasures were countless. They couldn't move them all for several months, and some had to be burned. Guangwu took advantage of the situation and captured Yingyang County. At this time, Liu Boxheng was killed by Liu Xuan, the Gengshi Emperor. Guangwu immediately rushed from his father city to Wancheng to apologize. The officials of the Situ Mansion all came to express their condolences to Guangwu. Guangwu was not in a position to discuss anything with them in private, but he only blamed himself deeply. He never boasted about his achievements in the Battle of Kunyang, nor did he dare to mourn for Bo Sheng. He ate, talked and laughed as naturally as usual. Emperor Gengshi felt guilty about this, so he worshiped Guangwu as the general of Polu and named him Marquis of Wuxin. On the third day of September, the three auxiliary heroes of Chang'an worked together to kill Wang Mang and sent his head to Wancheng. Emperor Gengshi was about to go north to make his capital Luoyang, so he asked Guangwu to act as Sili Xiaowei and asked him to go to Luoyang first to repair the palace and government offices. Guangwu then set up subordinate officials to draft official documents to conduct historical inspections and illegal affairs, and everything was handled according to the old system of the Han Dynasty. At this time, the three auxiliary officials went east to welcome Emperor Gengshi. When they saw the generals passing by, they all wore civilian headscarves, women's clothes, large tie-ups and embroidered half-armor, and everyone laughed at them. Some even run away in fear of disaster because of the ominous things they are convinced of. When they saw Guangwu's staff, they were all overjoyed. Some old officials shed tears and said: "I didn't expect to see the majesty and grace of my Han officials again today!" From then on, all knowledgeable people turned to Guangwu. In October, Guangwu took the talisman and crossed the Yellow River to the north to calm the officials and people of the prefecture and county. He vindicated wrongful cases, released prisoners, got rid of Wang Mang's harsh rule, and restored the official title of the Han Dynasty. source: At this time, it happened that Geng Kuang, the governor of Shanggu, and Peng Chong, the governor of Yuyang, respectively sent generals such as Wu Han and Kou Xun to lead elite cavalry to assist in attacking Wang Lang. Emperor Gengshi also sent Shangshu servant She Xie Gong to attack Wang Lang. Guangwu rewarded the soldiers well, and then marched eastward and surrounded Julu City. Wang Lang's general Wang Rao defended the city, and Guangwu failed to capture it for more than a month. Wang Lang also sent Ni Hong and Liu Feng to lead tens of thousands of troops to rescue Julu. Guangwu went to Nanxian to attack them head-on, killing thousands of enemy troops. In April, he marched again and besieged Handan, winning consecutive battles. On the day of Jiachen in the fifth month, Handan was captured and Wang Lang was killed. The documents were seized and it was discovered that the Han military officials had colluded with Wang Lang to slander Guangwu's letter, which was called Qianzhang. Without even looking at it, Guangwu summoned the generals to burn them, saying: "Let those who are tossing and turning calm down." Emperor Gengshi sent his censor, Shi Zhifujie, to make Guangwu the King of Xiao, asking him to cease the war and return to the seat of Emperor Gengshi. Guangwu declined, saying that Hebei had not yet been pacified and would not accept the order. From then on, Guangwu began to have second thoughts about Emperor Gengshi. At that time, the political situation in Chang'an was in chaos, and all parties rebelled against Gengshi Emperor. Liu Yong, the king of Liang, acted exclusively in Suiyang County, Gongsun Shu proclaimed himself king in Bashu, Li Xian established himself as the king of Huainan, Qin Feng claimed to be the king of Chuli, Zhang Bu raised troops in Langxie, Dong Xian raised troops in Donghai, Yancen raised troops in Hanzhong, and Tian Rong raised troops in Yiling. Guangwu was preparing to attack these thieves, so he first sent Wu Han to recruit soldiers and horses from ten counties to march north. When Miao Zeng, the governor of Youzhou, refused to obey, Wu Han killed him and mobilized his troops. In autumn, Guangwu attacked the Bronze Horse Army in the county. Wu Han led the elite cavalry to Qingyang County to join Guangwu. The Bronze Horse Army repeatedly challenged them, but Guangwu stood firm in the barracks and refused to fight back. Once someone from the Bronze Horse Army went out to rob property, Guangwu sent people to intercept them and cut off the Bronze Horse Army's food and grass channels. After more than a month of this, the Bronze Horse Army ran out of food and fled in the middle of the night. Guangwu led his army to pursue them to Guantao County and defeated the Bronze Horse Army. Before all the Bronze Horse Army surrendered, Gaohu and Chonglian came from the southeast to join the remaining Bronze Horse Army. Guangwu then fought fiercely with them in Puyang, defeated the enemy forces across the board and made them surrender, and named their generals as marquises. The surrendered generals still felt uneasy. Guangwu knew their doubts and asked them to return to their respective armies to manage the soldiers, and then he leisurely rode on horseback to inspect each battalion. The surrendered people talked among themselves and said: King Xiao confides in us, how can we not retaliate with death? From then on they were all convinced.

According to the law, the criminal should be sentenced to pay for his crime with his life. It happened to be the winter solstice, so Fu Qi let the criminal go home for reunion and let him return to prison after the winter solstice. The county official refused to release him and argued with Fu Qi: "This was done in ancient times, but it cannot be practiced now." source: Since the time of Qie Qianhou Chanyu, the Xiongnu territory has been invaded day by day, but we have been unable to recover. The Han Dynasty sent Han Chang, the commander of chariots and cavalry, to greet him, and ordered 2,000 cavalry from the seven counties that Hu Hanxie Shanyu was going to pass through to serve as guards on the roadsides. In the first month of the first lunar month, Hu Hanxie went to court to choose the emperor. The emperor treated him with special and solemn etiquette. The Emperor Huansu gave Bihan Xie Chanyu the official uniform of Huanqiao, a golden seal decorated with a ribbon dyed with rhizome, a sword with jade on the nose, a sword, a bow, twelve arrows, and a blouse. Ten halberds, a chariot, a set of saddles and bridles, fifteen horses, twenty kilograms of gold, two hundred thousand yuan, seventy-seven sets of clothes and quilts, a total of eight thousand pieces of brocade, satin and miscellaneous silk, and six thousand kilograms of coarse silk and cotton. After the court ceremony was completed, an envoy was sent to guide Shanyu to go ahead and live in Changping. The emperor went from Ganquan Palace to Chiyang Palace and lived there. When the emperor ascended the hillside of Changping, Shao ordered Shanzi not to come to pay him a visit. The ministers of the left and right households were allowed to line up to see him. The Han Dynasty sent Changle Guardsman Gaochanghou Dong Zhong and Chariot and Cavalry Commander Han Chang to lead 16,000 cavalry, as well as thousands of troops from border prefectures and counties to escort Huhanxie Chanyu out of Jilusai in Shuofang City. The emperor ordered Dong Zhong and others to stay there to protect Shanyu and help him attack the rebellious and disobedient people. The next year, the Han Dynasty sent Han Chang, the captain of chariots and cavalry, and Zhang Meng, the Guanglu doctor, to escort Hu Hanxie Shanyu's son, who was serving as a servant, back to the Huns. Han Chang and Zhang Meng saw that the Xiongnu tribe was prosperous and that all the animals under the fortress had been hunted down. Han and Zhang heard that many Xiongnu ministers advised the Shanyu to return to the north where they originally lived. Han Chang and Zhang Meng made an alliance with the Shanyu, saying: From now on, the Han Dynasty and the Xiongnu are one family, and they are not allowed to deceive or attack each other from generation to generation. When theft or robbery occurs, both parties must report to each other, punish the thief, and compensate for the lost property; when an enemy invades, they must send troops to rescue each other. If either the Han Dynasty or the Xiongnu dared to betray the alliance first, they would be willing to accept the punishment of heaven. Let their descendants and descendants suffer disaster just as the covenant says. Han Chang, Zhang Meng, Hu Hanxie Chanyu and his ministers climbed to Nuoshuishu Mountain of the Xiongnu and killed the white horse. The Chanyu used a path knife and a golden plow to stir the wine mixed with the blood of the horse, and used the head of the Yuezhi King whom the old Shanyu had killed as a wine cup, and they drank the blood wine together as an alliance.

source: After Zhizhi Chanyu was killed, Huhanxie Chanyu was happy and scared, and wrote to the Emperor Xuan: I often hope to go to see His Majesty, but it is actually because Zhizhi Chanyu lives in the west, and I am worried that he will attack me with Mercer, so I cannot go to see the Emperor. After the establishment of the Han Dynasty, they suffered particularly serious consequences. I heard that our northern border fortress reaches all the way to Liaodong. He made bows and arrows here, trained his troops, and came in and out of Yinshan to harass us. Yinshan was the garden where they raised animals. When Emperor Xiaowu arrived, he sent troops to attack and capture the area and drove them to the north of the desert. Border fortresses were built, sentry roads were built, cities outside the fortress were built, troops were stationed there, and then the border settled down a little. The terrain to the north of the desert is flat, with sparse vegetation and mostly sand and gravel. When the Xiongnu invaded, there was nothing to hide from. From the frontier fortress to the south, it is difficult to travel on the mountain roads. The old people on the border said that since the Huns lost Yinshan, they never failed to cry every time they passed by. Now if we withdraw the soldiers guarding the border fortress and show them such good favorable conditions, this is the first thing we cannot do. Now, the emperor, you are so generous and generous, and your kindness is like heaven covering the Huns. The Huns came to kowtow and proclaim themselves vassals because of the help of the Han Dynasty. The temperament of those Huns is to be humble and submissive when in danger, and to be arrogant and rebellious when they are strong. This is their nature. Some time ago, the Han Dynasty had abolished the cities outside the wall and reduced the number of troops stationed at checkpoints and key roads. The number now was enough to wait and see the situation and send beacon communications. The ancients said that we should be prepared for danger in times of peace, and the Han army cannot withdraw again. This is the second rule. In the Central Plains, there is education in etiquette and justice, and there are punishments as a means of punishment, but some ignorant people still dare to break laws and prohibitions, not to mention the Chanyu, can he definitely prevent his tribes from violating the covenant?

source: Shanyu thanked him and said: I don't understand the emperor's profound thoughts, but thanks to the emperor sending ministers to tell me, I am very grateful. The Chanyu apologized and said: "My lord, you planned for me at the beginning. Your kindness and kindness have made us Xiongnu peaceful and peaceful to this day. These are all due to you, lord.
